checks.instructions: Use real 1-4 keys and click destination ghosts to preview, Space to commit, Z to cancel or undo, R to restart. Check each arriving tip becomes the new pin and held Space never repeats. Escape must pause; F5/F9 must resume a swing and undo history.

Right-drag to orbit and wheel to zoom. Inspect the windows, overhead clearance and depth changes in all eight chambers; confirm the baton remains visible and the red first-contact marker explains obstruction.
Read instructions at 1280x800 and 1440x900. Distinguish the blue circle and orange diamond, current pin, arriving pin, ghost numbers, sockets, blocked arc, chamber completion and final victory.

Solve the tutorial by moving up then right. Check clear endpoints can still have a blocked arc in False Clearance, that rejected moves preserve the pin and pose, and that retry/undo are unlimited. Complete all eight chambers without a timer or move budget.
Listen for separate preview, blocked, handoff, undo and completion cues. Exercise Sound effects in Escape Settings. Software captures run muted and cannot verify hardware audio.
